info.description:
This cour will cover the following contents:

Part I       Introduction to Big Data

Part II      The big data key issues

clos.loDetails: Provide students with a solid understanding of the principles, methods and technologies for big data management to drive business innovations
Equip students with the essential knowledge and skills to design a plan for big data management and evaluate the effectiveness of the proposed solution
Enable students to apply the learnt methods and technologies in big data management for business improvements and innovations
